title: 3 nabbed, P112,000 worth of 'shabu' seized in Laoag buy-bust

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur—Three individuals were arrested after authorities seized more than P112,000 worth of suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) during a buy-bust operation in Barangay 13, Laoag City, Ilocos Norte on Friday, Oct. 16. According to police, the operation resulted in the confiscation of 13 heat-sealed plastic sachets containing suspected shabu weighing approximately 16.49 grams, including the packaging. The seized illegal drugs have an estimated standard drug price of P112,132, authorities said. The arrest was conducted jointly by the Laoag City Police Station and other law enforcement personnel.
